rules.R-DOMAIN-P0: Unresolved applicable P0 domain issues block new Scientific Freeze and Research Freeze.
rules.R-DEPTH-DECOUPLED: Question depth never creates page, figure, formula, benchmark, or ablation quotas.
rules.R-PAGE-OFFICIAL: Hard page limits require current-year official source and complete counting scope.
rules.R-CONTENT-INDEPENDENT: Content sufficiency is assessed even when hard page compliance is UNSET.
rules.R-BENCHMARK-CONDITIONAL: Benchmark requires genuine competitors or a comparative superiority claim.
rules.R-ABLATION-CONDITIONAL: Ablation requires a component contribution claim that can be removed or replaced.
rules.R-RESULT-TRACE: Every reported result resolves to a typed locator and matching artifact hash.
rules.R-VISUAL-ROLE: Applicable high-importance visual roles require a delivered figure or an evidenced equivalent expression.
rules.R-QA-HASH: Final page QA binds the exact document and rendered page hashes.
rules.R-FREEZE-DUAL: Scientific and Research Freeze have different gates and manifests.
rules.R-REOPEN: Research-frozen work may reopen for development while preserving unchanged scientific snapshots.
rules.R-RESOURCE-READONLY: Legacy resource roots are read-only and their workflow policies are not inherited.
rules.R-VISUAL-OPPORTUNITY: Visual candidates are derived from model/evidence needs and chart-family fit; broader chart vocabulary does not create a figure quota.
rules.R-DEVELOPMENT-NOT-COVERAGE: A locator or checklist hit does not by itself prove professional development; high-importance content must be substantively developed or explicitly justified as integrated.
rules.R-VISUAL-RICH-NOT-SPARSE: Mine broad visual opportunities, select actual evidence tasks; assess whole-paper density and redundancy only after all major texts, never by figure count or a mandatory editor role.
rules.R-KEY-DECISION-ONLY: KEY_DECISION_ONLY may stop after an executable domain/model/verification decision packet; it must not claim Scientific or Research Freeze and must not silently lower final quality gates.
rules.R-RETURN-AUDIT: In KEY_DECISION_ONLY collaboration, RETURN_AUDIT reuses execution evidence and selects substantive spot-checks by actual risk; no fixed check quota or full rerun without a concrete trigger.
rules.R-FINAL-GATES-PRESERVED: Both modes preserve scientific truth, critical validation, actual visual quality and final annual compliance. COARSE_ACCEPTED is not Freeze.
rules.R-COARSE-AUDIT-NO-DUPLICATION: Reuse verified evidence; escalate material scientific/visual defects without unrelated computations or nominal reviewer suites.
rules.R-REVIEW-RISK: One substantive core scientific review per question; specialist attacks only for material risks; integrated contest review after all major texts.
rules.R-SOURCE-EXACT: Exact source transcription; computational uncertainty and source-derived rounding are separate.
rules.R-NO-DECLARATION-PROOF: PASS text is not execution, independent computation, legal bound validity, causal identification or proof.
rules.R-VISUAL-INSPECT: Actual source, generation and final-size inspection; declined candidates have no production obligations.
rules.R-STAGE-ARTIFACTS: Current-stage artifacts and result-centered dependency graph, not administrative root scans.
